### Install (Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit)

1. Download **PhoneDrop-Setup.exe** below.
2. Run it. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed).
3. Follow the wizard and tick **Open PhoneDrop now**. At the end Windows asks **once** to allow changes: click **Yes** so phones can get through Windows Firewall. (No admin? Click No: PhoneDrop installs anyway and shows **Finish setup** until someone with admin clicks it.)

PhoneDrop installs just for you (no admin needed), so updates never ask again. Coming from PhoneDrop 1.x? The update moves it out of Program Files: click **Yes** once when Windows asks.

Then drop in photos or videos and scan the QR code with your phone (same Wi-Fi). On iPhone, tap **Save all to Photos**.

Already have PhoneDrop? It updates itself: when it says a new version is available, click **Update now**. No Windows prompt.

Full instructions and help: [README](https://github.com/dhairyakhetan/PhoneDrop#readme). PhoneDrop-Setup.exe.sha256 holds the installer's SHA-256 checksum.
